event_summary: An upright blue rectangular prism on a circular base turns slowly while its dark wall shadow changes position and shape.
raw_event_description: The video opens with a cyan-blue upright rectangular prism standing on a circular base on a tabletop in front of a light-colored wall. A large circular illuminated area is visible on the wall, and a dark shadow with a vertical segment and a lower horizontal segment is visible within it. Across the video, the prism remains upright on the base while its visible face widths and edges change gradually. At the same time, the vertical part of the wall shadow shifts gradually rightward and changes shape. The circular base, tabletop, wall, and visible cord remain in the same image positions. No breakage, detachment, or scene cut is visible.

reasons: The main upright blue prism, circular base, tabletop, wall, illuminated area, and wall shadow are all visible in the first frame.
The changing process is already underway at the beginning of the clip.
